lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase Mg12Ga2Sb2 (Mg6GaSb) crystallizes in space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga and Sb centers each with 8 geometric neighbors (4 Ga and 4 Mg for Ga, and 4 Mg and 4 Sb for Sb), while Mg centers have 14 neighbors. The connectivity forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ga and Mg polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Sb polyhedra.
